summary: Iteration 38 – Fahrkontrolle assessment photo upload/delete: Backend (8/8 pytest) + Frontend (RatingPopup camera flow + no-layout-shift + mobile regression) all PASS on preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend POST /photo uses `_ensure_assessment()` then $push into photo_urls – clean pattern; existing rating/comment untouched. GOOD.

Backend DELETE /photo returns an empty Assessment stub when the row was auto-deleted (all fields empty). The frontend correctly detects this and removes the assessment from local state (FahrkontrolleTab.jsx:253-260). GOOD.
Backend PUT /assessments now loads `existing` FIRST and honors `photo_urls` when deciding whether to delete the empty row. This is the correct fix for the iter38 requirement. GOOD.

RatingPopup.jsx – camera icon sits INSIDE the flex justify-between of the label row (same visual band). Photos grid is conditionally rendered ONLY when photoUrls.length > 0 → 0 vertical space when empty. Verified: textarea Y=592.5px identical before-upload and after-delete-photo (both zero-photo states).

Missing pytest ordering safety net: cross-class dependency `_uploaded_url` did fail on xdist. Fixed by consolidating into a single TestFahrkontrollePhotos class so loadscope pins to one worker. (Non-blocking after fix.)

core/storage.put_object() is a *sync* requests call inside an async endpoint – blocks the event loop briefly per upload. Not a bug but worth noting for future scale (consider run_in_executor or httpx.AsyncClient).
seed_data_creation: Backend pytest fixture creates & tears down its own student (TEST_it38 Photo) + category + subitem + lesson. Frontend playwright uploaded ONE photo into an empty existing cell and deleted it (self-cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter38 fully green. Endpoint contract for future work: POST /api/fahrkontrolle/students/{sid}/assessments/photo?subitem_id=X&lesson_id=Y (multipart 'file') → 200 Assessment with photo_urls appended; 400 for non-image; 413 for >10MB. DELETE same path + &url=… → 200 Assessment (empty stub if row was auto-deleted); 404 if no cell. Upsert PUT preserves existing photo_urls unless caller passes photos explicitly (which the schema doesn't allow anyway). Note: mobile screenshot shows one leftover thumbnail on cell L1/1.1 – irrelevant leftover from either main agent's manual test or the desktop-test-cycle's target (a *different* cell than the mobile target). Not a bug.

frontend_popup.camera_HORIZONTAL_to_label_right_side_sa: PASS (label center y=566.5, camera center y=566.5)
